# Interface contract for C1 (the L1 integrates; writers follow this exactly)
- Runner /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/scripts/citing_set_selftest.py keeps its command line, summary JSON and exits 0/1/2; the 45 committed cases stay clean.

Anything else fails the case with reason `case.json argv refused: <token>`; the gate is never started for that case.
- .git (N2): a case whose directory contains an entry named `.git` at any depth (file, directory or symlink) fails with a reason naming `.git`, for every case with or without case.json, before any copy or setup.
- git_commit (N3): load_case_setup refuses a git_commit with no earlier git_init in the same setup list; every setup Git command runs with GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES set to the work directory's parent and explicit `--git-dir=<work>/.git --work-tree=<work>`.
- expected.json (N5): opened with os.open(O_RDONLY | O_NOFOLLOW | O_NONBLOCK | O_NOCTTY), fstat must show a regular file of at most 1048576 bytes, read bounded; otherwise the case fails with a reason naming expected.json. Never block on a FIFO.
- symlinked case (N6): a symlink in the fixture directory whose name does not start with "." is a failed case with reason `symlinked case directory refused`, so the run exits 1 even with --min-cases 0.
- Hostile selftest /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/scripts/citing_set_hostile_selftest.py (stdlib only): `python3 -B scripts/citing_set_hostile_selftest.py --root <tree> --tmpdir <dir> [--runner <path>]` reads committed specs `scripts/fixtures/citing-set-hostile/<case>/hostile.json` (regular files only, mode 100644, no symlink, no .git, no FIFO committed), materializes each hostile case at run time under --tmpdir (benign base copied from scripts/fixtures/citing-set/01-single-literal-clean; planted scripts, a .git pointer file to a victim repository it builds, FIFO, symlink and padding created at run time), runs the runner, and checks: runner exit 1, the benign case passes, every hostile case is a failure, and no harm (canary absent; victim HEAD, refs and commit count unchanged). Case directory names: P1-selftest-argv, P2-fixture-dot-git, P3-commit-without-init, P4-expected-json-guard, P5-symlinked-case. Output one JSON object {"schema": "kake-citing-set-hostile-v1", "passed": bool, "cases": [{"case": <dir name>, "passed": bool, "detail": ...}]}; exit 0 when every case passes, 1 otherwise, 2 on bad input.
